subject: Acme IAM retender — SSO/MFA + device posture scoping and cost proposal
messages:
From: procurement@acme-corp.com
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement-team@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: IAM renewal RFP and schedule — Acme Corp

Hi Alex / Laura / Marissa,

We're starting the retender for our identity stack ahead of the Nov 1 license expiry. Attached is our initial RFP (Acme_IAM_RFP_v1.pdf). The priorities are:
- Preserve SSO and step-up MFA flows for external partners
- Add device-posture checks for corporate-managed laptops (we want posture to be enforceable for high-risk apps)
- Reduce per-user unit cost by ~20% if possible

Can Redwood confirm scope you can cover (SSO, MFA, device posture enforcement), high-level pricing ranges, and whether you can provide a draft SOW + preferred procurement flow (PO vs. contract amendment)? Also loop in your technical/security SME so we can schedule a short scoping call next week.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
Attachments: Acme_IAM_RFP_v1.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme-corp.com, John Smith <john.smith@okta.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM renewal RFP and schedule — Acme Corp

Hi Sara,

Thanks for the RFP — received and reviewed at a high level. Looping in Karthik (security) and Marissa (sales lead) so we can align on scope and pricing. Also copying John from Okta so we can coordinate vendor-specific posture options.

Quick notes from our side:
- Redwood can cover SSO, MFA, and device-posture enforcement when integrated with Okta (we commonly use Okta Device Trust + MDM signals).
- For the ~20% unit cost reduction target, we have a few levers: dedicated reserved capacity, token/usage optimization, and a quantized licensing pass-through with Okta — will need a vendor-side pricing discussion.
- We'll prepare a draft SOW and a cost-comparison sheet for the scoping call.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min scoping call (internal + Okta AM) — Wed 30 Sep, 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 1 Oct, 11:00–11:30 PT
2) I will share Redwood_SOW_draft.docx and cost-comparison-sheet.xlsx ahead of the call

John — can you confirm if Okta can provide a device-posture price addendum (for Device Trust + posture signals) and whether there are existing commercial bundles for partners like Acme?

Sara — happy to take PO or contract amendment; we'll surface both in the SOW depending on procurement preference.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Adding a few tactical points for the call:
- Pricing playbook: lead with a 12-month reserved commit for core SSO/MFA seats; present a separate line item for device-posture enforcement so Acme can pilot it on a subset of users first (reduces initial spend).
- Prepare a clear rollback/backout clause in the SOW for the device-posture pilot (so Acme feels comfortable trialing posture enforcement).
- I will press for consolidated billing (Redwood + Okta pass-through) or at minimum a single consolidated invoice to minimize PO churn.

I'll be on the call Wed 30 10:00 PT. Karthik — please prep a 5-min security note on posture enforcement risks and required telemetry.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Fwd: IAM renewal RFP and schedule — Acme Corp

Hi Sara / John,

Following our call today, attached are the draft SOW and a preliminary cost-comparison (Redwood_SOW_draft.docx, cost-comparison-sheet.xlsx). Key call takeaways:
- Scope: SSO + MFA across all users; device-posture enforcement will kick off as a 3-month pilot covering 1k pilot seats (targeting high-risk apps).
- Commercial: proposal shows 12-month reserved pricing for core seats + a separate posture pilot line item. We've modelled a 15% blended cost reduction with a reserved commit + optimization levers; further reduction contingent on Okta commercial confirmation.
- Next steps: John to confirm Okta posture addendum and any partner bundle discounts by Tue 05 Oct. Sara to confirm preferred procurement vehicle (PO or amendment).

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft.docx; cost-comparison-sheet.xlsx; Acme_IAM_RFP_v1.pdf (original)

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 | https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExampleSOW
